### R4-02 · Concept check

Lifetimes. Which construct exists only for the duration of one query?

A. VIEW
B. TEMPORARY VIEW
C. CTE (WITH …)
D. INDEX

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

**C**. A view lasts until dropped, a temporary view lasts until the connection closes, and a CTE lasts for one statement.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L636-638](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“But a CTE exists for a single query.”*</sub>

### R4-03 · Predict the output

Dataset `longlist` after setup:

```sql
CREATE VIEW "v" AS SELECT COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "ratings" WHERE "book_id" = 2;
INSERT INTO "ratings" ("book_id", "rating") VALUES (2, 5);
```
```sql
SELECT "n" FROM "v";
```
What is printed?

A. `176`
B. `177`
C. `ERROR: view is stale`

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

**B**. A view re-runs its query every time, so it always reflects the current data.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L519-526](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“Every time I query this view”*</sub>

### R4-04 · Predict the output

Dataset `longlist` after setup:

```sql
CREATE VIEW "2021" AS SELECT "id", "title" FROM "books" WHERE "year" = 2021;
```
```sql
DELETE FROM "2021" WHERE "id" = 34;
```
What is printed?

A. `(no rows)`
B. `ERROR: cannot modify 2021 because it is a view`

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

**B**. SQLite views are read-only unless an INSTEAD OF trigger handles the write.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L837-838](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“cannot modify 2021 because it is”*</sub>

### R4-05 · Concept check

You give an analyst the rideshare.db file with an anonymizing view. What stops them reading rider names?

A. The view hides the base table
B. Nothing. SQLite has no per-user access control
C. PRAGMA secure_delete
D. Temporary views

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

**B**. In SQLite you give access to the whole file or nothing. Real access control needs MySQL/PostgreSQL GRANT.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L962-968](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“I either give you”*</sub>

### R4-06 · Quick review

How does an INSTEAD OF INSERT trigger choose between "re-activate" and "insert new"?

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

Two triggers with complementary WHEN conditions: `WHEN NEW.accession_number IN (SELECT …)` updates deleted = 0, and `WHEN … NOT IN (…)` inserts a new row.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L1236-1242](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“one that runs when the item is already in our table”*</sub>

### R4-07 · Predict the output

Dataset `longlist`:

```sql
WITH "a" AS (SELECT 1 AS "x"), "b" AS (SELECT "x" + 1 AS "y" FROM "a")
SELECT "y" FROM "b";
```
What is printed?

A. `1`
B. `2`
C. `ERROR: no such table: a`

<details><summary>Answer</summary>

**B**. A later CTE can use an earlier one. Separate CTEs with commas, with no comma after the last.
</details>

<sub>Source: [lecture4 L642-646](../sources/lecture4.txt) *“I could then optionally follow it up with more CTEs”*</sub>
